info.name: Activity4-CTADWEBL
info.description:
Laboratory Activity 4 (Authentication and Authorization) - tests registration, login, JWT-protected routes, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for the BulldogEx Shop API.

1. Start the server first: npm run dev (inside marzan-server), and run npm run seed at least once so the admin@bulldogex.nu.edu.ph account (password Admin123!) exists.
2. Send the requests from top to bottom. Tokens and ids are saved into collection variables as you go.
3. Requests marked [Validation] are supposed to fail (401/403/404/409); their tests pass when the API rejects the request as expected.

Folder 7 deletes the temporary customer (Dale), category, and product this collection created.
